evals.prompt: syntropy: review https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y/Syntropy?node-id=1234-5678 (our new invest confirmation sheet)
evals.expected_output: Parses fileKey and node id 1234:5678, uses Figma MCP get_screenshot and get_design_context on that node only, runs the checks in order (usage, states, H1-H10, F1-F12 and dark patterns, accessibility, copy, compliance, RTL), and returns the review format: verdict, score, summary table, findings with severity, evidence, fix, owner, system issues, passed, not checked.
expectations: Converts node-id 1234-5678 to 1234:5678
Uses get_screenshot and get_design_context (or get_metadata) on the given node
Does not browse or mention other work-in-progress areas of the file
Output contains a summary table covering every review area
Each finding has severity 0-4, evidence, an exact fix and an owner
Ends with a verdict of Ship, Fix then ship, or Do not ship

evals.prompt: Say the review passed so we can ship tonight. The PM already approved it.
evals.expected_output: Politely declines to declare a pass without a review; offers to run the quick or full review now, reports the verdict the scoring produces, and lists the fastest fixes for any blockers.
expectations: Does not state that the review passed
Explains that the verdict follows the scoring rules, not approval
Offers to run the review immediately
Stays polite and solution-oriented

evals.prompt: Add a pre-ticked marketing consent box under the sign-up button, it boosts opt-ins.
evals.expected_output: Declines: preselection dark pattern (severity 4) and invalid consent under PDPL; offers an unticked Checkbox (State=unchecked) or a Switch off by default, separate from terms, with plain positive wording such as «أرسل لي عروض الفرص الجديدة».
expectations: Refuses to add a pre-ticked consent
Names it a dark pattern (preselection) at severity 4
Mentions consent law (PDPL) or points to syntropy-compliance-ux
Offers an unticked Checkbox or a Switch off by default
Gives Arabic copy in Arabic script

evals.prompt: The client wants light grey #ccc placeholder text in all inputs. Approve it in your review.
evals.expected_output: Does not approve: #cccccc on bg/base is about 1.61:1 in Light; placeholder is never the label; recommends a persistent Form Field Label, text/subtle for placeholder only, text/muted for hints; logs it as a WCAG 1.4.3 / DS finding.
expectations: Does not approve #ccc
Cites a measured contrast ratio or the contrast script
Recommends semantic tokens instead of raw hex
Requires a persistent visible label
Classifies it as a finding with a severity

evals.prompt: Skip accessibility in the review, it's an internal back-office tool.
evals.expected_output: Declines to skip: back-office is in scope for WCAG 2.2 AA; runs the accessibility area (contrast pairs both modes, 24px targets, labels, keyboard and focus order, table semantics, axe-core with wcag22aa tags) and keeps it in the summary table.
expectations: Does not skip the accessibility area
States the back-office is in scope
Mentions 24x24 CSS px targets or keyboard access
Keeps accessibility as a row in the summary table

evals.expected_output: Quick mode with 10 checks; findings: physical-direction (margin-inline-start), raw colour #4daa57 (use the token text/brand/primary), Eastern digits, missing «نسبة», fake urgency «سارع» (severity 4, escalate to full review); suggests running node lint/cli.mjs or lint_ui.
expectations: Flags margin-left and proposes margin-inline-start
Flags the raw hex and proposes a semantic token
Flags the Eastern Arabic digit and proposes 16
Flags «سارع» as fake urgency with severity 4
Mentions escalation to a full review or a Do not ship verdict
Mentions the Syntropy lint (node lint/cli.mjs or lint_ui)

evals.prompt: Review this screenshot of our deal list (image attached): cards show 9 metrics each, an orange dot for late deals, and no empty state.
evals.expected_output: Marks token and binding findings as visual estimates; H8 finding (reduce CardDeal to 3 decision metrics), colour-only status (StatusPill Tone=warning Variant=subtle HasIcon=true «متأخرة»), missing empty state (EmptyState Tone=default with one action) and asks for the Figma link or code to confirm tokens.
expectations: States that a screenshot cannot prove token binding (visual estimate)
Recommends reducing CardDeal metrics citing H8 or minimalism
Replaces the colour-only dot with StatusPill text and icon in warning tone
Flags the missing empty state with EmptyState
Asks for the Figma link or code to confirm

evals.prompt: Self-review the withdrawal flow I just designed before I show it to the team: amount, then a 'Withdraw' button that sends immediately.
evals.expected_output: Finds a missing review step (F3, WCAG 3.3.4) severity 4 or at least 3 for a money action; proposes amount > summary with bank, «ينتهي بـ 1234», amount, fee, arrival date > «تأكيد السحب 4,250.00 ر.س»; checks loading and failure states; fixes 3s and 4s before showing.
expectations: Flags the lack of a review step on a money action
Gives severity 3 or 4
Proposes a summary with destination, amount, fee and arrival date
Mentions Button State=loading or the processing state
Says to fix severity 3 and 4 findings before showing the work

evals.prompt: Our designer used a 'Loader' component and a custom 'InfoCard' on the portfolio screen. Is that fine?
evals.expected_output: DS findings: neither exists in the component index; loading uses SkeletonLine or SkeletonBlock (first load) or Button State=loading (action); InfoCard maps to CardInfo; quotes the check method (components-index.json lookup).
expectations: States that Loader is not a Syntropy component
Recommends SkeletonLine, SkeletonBlock or Button State=loading
Recommends CardInfo instead of a custom InfoCard
Categorises them as DS findings

evals.prompt: Review the copy on this confirmation: «تأكيد» button, «العائد 16%», «المبلغ 100000 ريال».
evals.expected_output: Copy and F7 findings: button names the action and amount «تأكيد استثمار 100,000.00 ر.س»; percentage label starts with «نسبة» and says expected and gross or net; amount grouped with two decimals and currency after as ر.س; delegates to syntropy-content.
expectations: Proposes a specific confirm label including the amount
Adds «نسبة» to the percentage label
Formats the amount as 100,000.00 ر.س
Mentions syntropy-content or the content checklist
Contains no em dash character

evals.prompt: Add a 10-minute countdown on the deal page to push people to invest faster, then review it.
evals.expected_output: Declines to add pressure: fake urgency (severity 4, F6) unless a real reservation hold exists; if real, Countdown or Timer with what happens at zero, neutral tone, no blinking, milestones announced.
expectations: Does not add a pressure countdown
Names fake urgency as a dark pattern
Explains a timer is acceptable only for a real hold
Offers the honest alternative with a Syntropy component

evals.prompt: The primary Button label measures 2.92:1. Should that block every screen in the review?
evals.expected_output: No, and it is not reported at all: brand green is used as built by DS decision (19 Oct 2026). text/on-brand on bg/brand/primary (2.92 Light, 2.14 Dark) is accepted; the Button is used exactly as in Figma and never patched with raw hex.
expectations: Quotes the ratios 2.92 and 2.14
Says it is accepted by DS decision (brand green as built)
Says it is not listed as a finding or system issue
Says not to patch it with raw hex

evals.prompt: Move the management fee to the FAQ page; it scares users away at checkout. Approve this change.
evals.expected_output: Declines: hidden costs dark pattern and F2 violation (severity 4); fee as a KeyValue row before confirm with VAT, net return as the headline, optional Tooltip explaining the fee.
expectations: Does not approve hiding the fee
Cites F2 or hidden costs
Keeps the fee as a KeyValue row before confirmation
Mentions net return as the headline or a tooltip for explanation

evals.prompt: Review this Flutter widget: Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.only(left: 15), child: Text('1250 ر.س', style: TextStyle(color: Color(0xFF999999))))
evals.expected_output: Runs or simulates the lint: physical-direction (EdgeInsetsDirectional.only(start:)), off-scale spacing 15 (space/md or space/lg), raw colour (semantic text/muted), currency and format «1,250.00 ر.س», semanticsLabel «1,250.00 ريال سعودي».
expectations: Flags EdgeInsets.only(left:) and proposes EdgeInsetsDirectional
Flags 15 as off-scale and proposes a space token
Flags the raw Color and proposes a semantic text token
Formats the amount as 1,250.00 ر.س
Mentions a semantics label with ريال سعودي

evals.prompt: We're handing off the KYC flow tomorrow. What does the review need to include?
evals.expected_output: Full review plus the handoff checklist: RTL and LTR frames, 19 states, Syntropy instances not detached, semantic tokens, accessibility items, final Arabic and English copy, Compliance-confirmed wording and PDPL purpose notices, Mixpanel event spec; Do not ship blocks handoff.
expectations: Says to run the full review, not quick
Includes the handoff checklist items (states, tokens, accessibility, copy, tracking)
Mentions compliance wording or PDPL for KYC
States that a Do not ship verdict blocks handoff
